questions.title: Can we download the open-source version now?
questions.answer: The public version has not been released. Apache-2.0 is the planned license. You can assess workflow fit, data formats and preparation now. Downloads and installation documents will correspond to a released version.

questions.title: Does every factory with shifts fit?
questions.answer: Shift work is not the same as variable working-hour arrangements. The first release excludes Taiwan’s two-, four- and eight-week variable working-hour regimes. Asper reviews arrangements, shifts and punch formats before assessing fit.

questions.title: Do we need paid assistance to use the core?
questions.answer: After release, factories can use the core under its public license. Paid Asper work covers migration, configuration, training, acceptance and agreed support or maintenance.

questions.title: Can IT get installation and compatibility documents now?
questions.answer: First-release deployment requirements and compatibility are still being validated. Review data and maintenance needs first. Versioned installation, backup/restore and upgrade documents will accompany the release.

questions.title: Can we use ESG services with our existing ERP?
questions.answer: Start with existing ERP, spreadsheets or documents. An ESG project defines data needs for a specific deliverable, and your factory can keep its existing systems.

questions.title: How does Asper access a self-hosted factory’s data?
questions.answer: The factory manages its data. Adoption or ESG services require a separate agreement on authorized data, purposes and service scope.

carbon.audience: For ESG, finance, factory operations, and IT teams
carbon.description: Asper organizes activity data and supporting records for the agreed site, period, and emission sources. Both parties confirm the inventory boundary and emission factors before reviewing the working papers.
inputs: Site, period, emission sources, and inventory boundary agreed together
Fuel consumption, purchases, and opening and closing inventory
Electricity, other energy, and activity data and documents for agreed emission sources
Emission factor sources, versions, and supporting records agreed together

carbon.nextStep: Tell us the site, period, customer deadline, and available energy or consumption records. We can confirm the inventory boundary and emission factors together later.
carbon.request: Your customer needs factory inventory data.

pcf.nextStep: Tell us the product, customer requirements, deadline, and available material or production records. We can confirm the product boundary and allocation method together later.
pcf.request: Your customer needs one product’s carbon footprint data.
pcf.scope: Product emission calculations, a formal carbon footprint report, consultant involvement, and third-party verification are subject to a separate agreement on work, responsibilities, and fees.

questions.title: Do we need to adopt Nexus ERP first?
questions.answer: Keep your existing ERP and start with Excel files, documents, or authorized exports. Asper reviews the data and gaps before agreeing on an import or integration method.

questions.title: Can we start with incomplete data or undecided emission factors and allocation methods?
questions.answer: Start by explaining the customer requirements, deadline, site or product, and available data. We can confirm boundaries, emission factors, and allocation methods together later. The full data list is not needed for the first conversation.

questions.title: Are purchasing and inventory records enough for a carbon inventory or PCF?
questions.answer: They provide part of the data. A carbon inventory also needs energy, actual consumption, and activity data for the agreed emission sources. PCF also needs a product boundary, materials, production volumes, processes, and allocation basis.

questions.title: Does our ERP need an API connection?
questions.answer: We assess the connection method first. Based on export formats and data quality, both parties confirm whether CSV or Excel import or API integration is feasible, how updates will work, and who is responsible.

questions.title: Does delivery include emission calculations, formal reports, or third-party verification?
questions.answer: The listed data registers, working papers, and evidence packs are delivered within the project agreement. Emission calculations, formal reports, consultant involvement, and third-party verification require a separate agreement on work, responsibilities, and fees.

questions.title: How do we define the first paid project?
questions.answer: Confirm one delivery requirement, a contact, and a deadline, then choose a period, site, or product. Asper reviews available data and gaps before both parties agree on deliverables, scope, and pricing.
